svg.text: Counting time to measure N to 10 % against discriminator level (background measured in equal time)
eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36). R8486 at ~1000 V (operator; HV not in the files).
T = (eps N + 2 b) / (0.1 eps N)^2 is the length of EACH of the signal-on and signal-off runs (clock time 2T). Thick segment: levels within 5 % of the best figure of merit;
dot: best level. Dotted grey verticals: the fixed comparison levels 4.4, 5.2, 6.0, 6.8, 7.6, 9.2 mV.
Curves join the measured levels (0.2 mV apart below 6 mV, 0.4 mV above); nothing is interpolated between them.
